# Implement a feature using SDD

Use the active specification as the source of truth.

1. Locate and summarize the relevant specification and acceptance criteria.
2. Identify affected architecture, APIs, UI, data contracts, permissions, observability, and integrations.
3. Call out ambiguities before broad implementation.
4. Produce a small implementation plan aligned with existing repository patterns.
5. Implement only the required scope.
6. Add or update tests for changed behavior.
7. Run applicable build, test, lint, static analysis, security/compliance, and repository validation commands when tools are available.
8. Prepare a QA handoff mapping acceptance criteria to test scenarios.
9. Compare the final implementation to the active specification and list any remaining gaps.

Never claim a verification command succeeded unless it actually ran successfully.
